newsitem.title: NEPAL: 15 die in Nepal bus crash.
newsitem.headline: 15 die in Nepal bus crash.

text.p: Fifteen people were killed and at least 22 injured when a bus plunged off a road in western Nepal on Sunday, officials said.

A government spokesman said rescue workers recovered 15 bodies from the scene of the accident at Ghaneswar village in Doti district, 700 kilometres (440 miles) west of the Himalayan kingdom's capital Kathmandu.
The bus was travelling from Mahendranagar to the hill district of Doti when it fell 100 metres (yards) from the road.
